item.title: Pope Leo warns of 'paradise of machines' during France visit
item.description: Pope Leo XIV expressed existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights in a speech during his first papal visit to France.

item.title: Global pandemic treaty signed but stalled in 'limbo'
item.description: The treaty aims to help countries prepare for and defeat future pandemics. Why has it not gone into effect?

item.title: Jay-Z accuser retracts sexual assault allegations
item.description: The woman known as Jane Doe filed a declaration in Manhattan federal court on Thursday, stating that all her original claims against the rapper were false.
